key_insight: CRC-HGD is a new labeled histopathology image dataset for colorectal cancer grading, covering three WHO differentiation grades at four magnification levels.
clinical_relevance: It provides a structured foundation for developing and validating AI tools that may support more consistent colorectal cancer grading in pathology workflows.
method: 214 colorectal adenocarcinoma patients, 1,914 H&E-stained microscopy images
WHO-based grading into Grade I (106), Grade II (75), and Grade III (33)
evidence_signal: The dataset is explicitly sized and labeled in the abstract, but the paper summary does not report model performance or benchmark evaluation results.
watch_item: Class imbalance across grades, especially the smaller Grade III group, may affect model training and fairness if not handled carefully.
paper_title: CRC-HGD: A Histopathological Image Dataset for Grading Colorectal Cancer
